title: FLA import: stroke pixelHinting and scaleMode flags skipped in readLineStyle
description: readLineStyle() in flash8-binary.ts skips 2 bytes: pixelHinting (1 byte) and scaleMode (1 byte, noHScale/noVScale/normal/none). Fix: decode both, add to SolidStroke model, encode LINESTYLE2 NoHScaleFlag/NoVScaleFlag/PixelHintingFlag bits in shapes.ts.
